title: Design thinking in five stages
caption: Start from people, then iterate. The stages are not strictly linear: teams loop back as they learn, and good ideas balance what is desirable, feasible and viable.
alt: Five boxes in order: empathise, define, ideate, prototype, test.
description: Empathise: observe and interview the people affected.
Define the problem from their point of view.
Test with users, looping back as you learn.
